messages:
emma: Heads-up: nightly SAST threw up a cluster of findings tied to header logging in the DAST client after we applied the RBAC rename + KMS rotation. Saw an Authorization header in staging logs.

raj: Can you paste a scrubbed line and approx timestamp? We need to know if a secret leaked to persistent logs or just ephemeral stdout.

emma: Scrubbed excerpt: `[2026-04-12T02:14:05Z] dast-client GET /health 200 - headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer [REDACTED-TRUNC]' }` Happened during canary run right after config reload.

selina: Quick context: infra renamed svc/dast-runner -> svc/dast-scan at 2026-04-12T01:30Z and rotated the staging KMS key at 2026-04-12T00:50Z. Probably token provider failed and code fell back to verbose logging.

oncall: Immediate actions: (1) revoke staging scanner tokens, (2) flip scanner auth=false in staging, (3) snapshot current logs & upload to secure bucket for audit, (4) add logging middleware to redact Authorization before any log emission.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-067. Owners: infra-oncall, sec-audit.

emma: I'll open a hotfix PR to stop direct header dumps and add a unit test that ensures logs don't include the string 'Bearer'.

raj: Also run a log grep across the retention window for `Authorization: Bearer` and include container IDs. If hits outside staging, escalate. Command example: `gcloud logging read "textPayload: \"Authorization: Bearer\"" --start=2026-04-12T00:00:00Z --end=2026-04-12T03:00:00Z`

selina: I'll produce a canonical mapping for the RBAC rename so audit shows a single principal. Upload plan: tar.gz -> s3://redwood-sec/incidents/INC-2026-067/ and HMAC manifest.

oncall: Good. Schedule a 60-min postmortem tomorrow. Keep this thread updated with evidence links and PR numbers.

emma: PR opened: https://git.example/infra/dast/pull/118 — removes header dump & adds redaction. Will roll canary after CI.

raj: Running grep now. Will paste findings to the incident if anything suspicious.

selina: Drafted mapping CSV and will upload evidence bundle after we revoke tokens.

oncall: Thanks team. Prioritize containment; sec will produce compliance packet once artifacts uploaded.
